description: ol-unknown-command (issue #117): a callee that isn't visible (not a Core primitive, reserved word, or declared procedure) raises ol-unknown-command with a Levenshtein did-you-mean suggestion when a visible candidate is within edit distance 2. Uses the parenthesized variadic form `(prnt 5)` so the misspelled zero-arity-unknown callee still parses cleanly (an unrecognized bare callee otherwise falls back to arity 0 and leaves its argument as a stray token, which today reports a parse-stage ol-bad-token blaming the argument; the #814 ruling makes that non-conforming and #815 owns closing it, so it is a known gap rather than a property of this rule).
